policy.actions: XLF/XLRE must pass the explicit source admission; no fake XLF split, extra ranking asset, fabricated fractional cash, excluded symbol or shortened sample.
policy.cash: T+1 current-account counterfactual, completed-settlement availability, no ex-date dividend cash. Original issuer/action evidence required.
policy.entry: Next week first eligible session open; freeze signal and dollar targets at decision time; existing settled cash only.
policy.exit: Following week first session open, even for repeated names; delayed entry keeps this exit and is skipped if entry reaches it.
policy.fees: EquityFeeBook 2026-09-17, explicitly a current-fee historical counterfactual.
policy.inference: Count weeks rather than simultaneous ETF legs; no post-outcome VIX filter.
policy.prior_inspection: SPY overlaps previously inspected #5/#6/C01/C06 history; source reuse does not create fresh evidence or restore any consumed holdout.
policy.selection: Highest training net dollar P&L at 10 bp; variant order breaks ties; only a profitable frozen selection may attempt one final at 10 bp.
policy.signal: Last exchange close of each NY Monday-Sunday week; sector trailing total return minus SPY; lowest negative residuals only; alphabetical ties.
policy.weights: 95% divided by top_n; absent eligible names leave their slots cash; $140 initial simulated allocation, 5% reserve, floor venue quantities, skip sub-$1 orders.
